description.text: Starter Set Legend Solgaleo-GX & Lunala-GX, a 60-card deck released on 10 November 2017 with both Legendary Pokémon-GX guaranteed, made to be strengthened with the GX Battle Boost high-class pack of 20 October. It was the first printing of the Supporter Cynthia, soon a staple of competitive decks. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a GX marker, a rule book and a player's guide came with it. A Premium Edition the same day added a Rockruff promo, a holo Lycanroc (Dusk Form) promo, one pack each of eight expansions and a deck case.
